author: jessica, as Momo Hazuki
source: his 2026-11-02 06:27: "write anotger 3 missions with droppods in them, they are cool"
_note: DROP PODS, 2 of 3. A comic defence: a homesteader raided by pod so often she has the timing down. Talk first, so she is met before anything lands; then the pods come down on the site.

ELIZA: the person is placed at quest start and the pods land 15 to 25 m round RECenterLocRef while she stands at REMarkerMediumLocRef. Nothing relies on her surviving (his 10-24): her lines all come before the drop and the close is the speaker on the radio. But if a pod crew kills her the player sees it. Is a talk person protected, or should she be?
The clear's near trigger may fire at once if he is already inside 250 after the talk (unmeasured, recipe doc). For a defence that is the wanted behaviour: they land as soon as the chat ends.
Momo's register: genki, delighted by small logistics, never sad. Voice borrowed until his ear casts it. No names, places, factions or currency in any voiced line.

FRANCES 2026-11-02 (reviews/2026-11-02-delve-MB95a.md): rework, findings 1-6 taken, 7 kept. Forced pick answered YES: the raiders are on her schedule today, so the walk-up says he is in time and the fight arrives when she said.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Settlement Contract. Defend the <Place> on <Planet> from a drop pod raid. Payment on contract completion."

place._theme: Quiet sites with residents, open sky at the centre for the pods.

prose.name: Defense: Drop Pods at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders keep dropping onto the <Place> by pod. The homesteader there has the timing worked out and wants someone standing in the open when they land.
prose.card: Raiders keep dropping onto the <Place> by pod. I've got the timing worked out. I need someone standing in the open when they land.

beats.objective: Talk to the homesteader at the <Place>
beats.journal: I met the homesteader at the <Place>. She says the raiders drop in by pod, and soon, and I need to be out in the open when they land.

person.name: Pip Arden
hellos: Oh good, you're in time. Just.

greeting: You came! Brilliant. They drop in by pod, a few at a time, and always just after I put the kettle on. I've timed it. Ask me anything you like, but be quick, they're nearly due.

exchanges.prompt: I'll be here when they land.
reply: Lovely! Stand where they can see you. They always come down looking for the most interesting thing, and today that's you.
And let them land with nobody here to complain? They'd only get comfortable. No, I like it here. I like it even better when they've gone.

exchanges.prompt: Why would anyone drop pods on you?
reply: That's what I keep asking! Somebody pays good money to drop people on my doorstep, and not one of them has ever wiped their feet.

beats._at: The open middle of the site, for the pods' sky.
beats.objective: Clear the pod crews at the <Place>
beats.journal: I cleared the pod crews at the <Place>.
say: That's all of them, and that's the quietest it's been all week! Come back any time you like. Preferably without the pods.
